answer: Locks are written down in beacon, expire in quill, and dawn lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 185 aliases therefore needs 97 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1027 identities would post 748 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
